positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched under John DiGiovanni Ph.D., Department of Pharmacology 
- Performed molecular research focused on understanding environmentally induced prostate cancer 
- Investigated how specific cellular signaling pathways were disrupted during tumor development and progression in human prostate cells 
- Maintained transgenic mice colonies by breeding, weaning, genotyping, and euthanizing mice

positions.title: Lead Mentor - TIP Scholars
positions.description:
- Coordinated and led weekly mentor trainings to 80+ upper-class mentors focused on teaching transferable skills that generated robust academic success and a 50% program increase
- Managed weekly mentor updates designed to capture student progress of 300+ college freshmen and intervened with students facing high risk situations
